name: Focus Points
description: Spend Focus Points on Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, Step of the Wind, or other Monk features. Save DC = 8 + Wisdom modifier + Proficiency Bonus. Regain all points after a Short or Long Rest.

name: Uncanny Metabolism
description: When you roll Initiative, regain all expended Focus Points. Also regain HP equal to your Monk level + 1d6. Regain this use after a Long Rest.
